claims.claim: The Home Depot reported second quarter fiscal 2026 sales of $47.9 billion.
Second quarter fiscal 2026 sales were an increase of $2.6 billion from the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Net sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $47.861 billion, compared to $45.277 billion in the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Net earnings for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.766 billion, compared to $4.551 billion in the same period of fiscal 2025.
Second quarter fiscal 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share were $4.79, compared to $4.58 in the same period of fiscal 2025.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.92, compared with $4.68 in the same period of fiscal 2025.
Comparable sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 1.7%.
Comparable sales in the U.S. increased 1.3% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
The company noted broad based demand across the business as customers continued to engage in smaller projects.
Comparable average ticket for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 was $92.50, compared to $90.01 in the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
claims.note: Wrong metric label. The release reports $92.50 vs. $90.01 as 'Average ticket'; 'Comparable average ticket' is a percent change (+2.8% in Q2 FY2026 vs. +1.4% in Q2 FY2025). Average ticket also excludes HD Supply and SRS, which the brief does not note here.

claims.claim: Customer transactions (excluding results from HD Supply or SRS) for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were 443.2 million, a decrease from 446.8 million in the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
The company reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 guidance.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes comparable sales growth of approximately flat to 2.0%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance for adjusted operating margin is approximately 12.8% to 13.0%.
The company expects to add approximately 15 new stores during fiscal 2026.
Capital expenditures for the six months ended August 2, 2026, were $(1,724) million.
Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $2,085 million, compared to $2,804 million at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Long-term debt, excluding current installments, was $43,951 million as of August 2, 2026.
IEEPA tariff refunds are expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy, and other product input costs throughout fiscal 2026.
The fiscal 2026 adjusted operating margin guidance excludes an expected approximately 40 basis point impact from acquired intangible asset amortization.
Net interest expense is guided to be approximately $2.3 billion for fiscal 2026.
